label: haplotype network
purpose: INV haplotype-network cartridge. Reuses shared/mgl_haplotype_network to cluster INV chromosomes by Hamming radius and lay out a minimum spanning tree between cluster representatives. Nodes sized by chromosome count, coloured by 2D-SFS subgroup.
input_contract: atlasState.inversion.haplotype_network_state = { dosage, n_markers, n_samples, inv_idx, sample_labels?, candidate_label?, view_state?: { hamming_radius?, layout_seed?, show_labels? } }
subdir_files: renderer.js — canvas painter (force-directed via Mulberry32 PRNG)
computed_preview_outputs: minimum-spanning haplotype network: nodes = Hamming-radius clusters; edges = pairwise mutational distance
